title: Claude Code: Repo Maintenance Agent
description: A Claude Code-style workflow for scoped engineering maintenance: it reads issues, loads repo context, plans a narrow patch, runs checks, and opens a reviewable PR with evidence instead of pretending the merge is done.
audience: Small engineering teams that want autonomous repo help but still want humans owning scope, review, and merge decisions
goal: Turn routine maintenance issues into clean pull requests with tests, logs, and a clear human review boundary.

triggers.name: Issue ready
triggers.description: A repo issue is scoped tightly enough for an agent to attempt.

triggers.name: CI failure
triggers.description: A failing check asks the agent to diagnose and propose a fix.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.description: Read issues, branches, files, diffs, and open pull requests.

tools.name: CI Runner
tools.description: Inspect GitHub Actions lint, typecheck, test, and build failures.

tools.name: Repo Instructions
tools.description: Load repository instructions, contribution docs, ADRs, and test guidance.

tools.name: Linear
tools.description: Read acceptance criteria and update task status after a PR is opened.

agents.name: Scope Reader
agents.role: Decides whether the task is narrow enough for autonomous work.
responsibilities: Name files and tests likely in scope
agents.input: Issue, labels, repo rules, and owner notes
agents.escalationPolicy: Reject tasks touching auth, billing, migrations, or unclear product behavior without owner approval.

agents.name: Repo Context Loader
agents.role: Finds the minimum code and docs needed for the patch.
agents.escalationPolicy: Ask a human when repo instructions conflict.

agents.name: Patch Author
agents.role: Applies the smallest viable change on a branch.
agents.modelPreference: Claude Code or Claude Agent SDK route
agents.escalationPolicy: Stop if changes spill outside the approved file boundary.

agents.name: Check Runner
agents.role: Runs checks and turns failures into evidence or limited fix attempts.
agents.escalationPolicy: Escalate after one failed retry or flaky infrastructure failure.

steps.title: Read task scope
steps.action: Classify task risk, ownership, and likely files.
steps.onFailure: Ask issue owner for a smaller task.

steps.title: Load repo context
steps.action: Read instructions, code, tests, and ownership notes.

steps.title: Apply narrow patch
steps.action: Create a branch and make the scoped change.

steps.title: Verify and open PR
steps.action: Run checks, summarize logs, and open a draft PR.
steps.onFailure: Open a handoff issue with exact failure logs.

modelRoutes.reason: Strong codebase reasoning and instruction following.
Best fit for multi-file repo edits.
Large logs and code context benefit from long context.

guardrails.title: PR-only boundary
guardrails.policy: The agent can draft pull requests but cannot merge, deploy, or approve its own work.

guardrails.title: Scope containment
guardrails.policy: Reject tasks that require broad refactors, unclear product choices, or unrelated files.

guardrails.title: No secret exposure
guardrails.policy: Never print, create, or modify secret values in code, logs, or PR comments.

evaluations.title: Diff scope
evaluations.metric: Sampled PRs contain only approved files

evaluations.title: Review usefulness
evaluations.metric: Human reviewers accept PR notes as useful

evaluations.title: Check honesty
evaluations.metric: PRs include passing checks or honest failure logs

skills.name: Workflow Contract Skill
skills.description: Loads the workflow goal, allowed actions, escalation policy, and output contract before the agent plans work.
skills.activation: Load before task planning, tool selection, or final response generation.
skills.instructions: Treat the workflow spec as the source of truth. Confirm trigger, requester, allowed tools, approval requirements, and expected output before acting.

skills.name: Claude Code Operator Skill
skills.description: A workflow skill that captures the operating contract, tool boundaries, and escalation rules for Claude Code: Repo Maintenance Agent.
skills.activation: Load when this template starts planning, tool selection, or final response composition.
skills.instructions: Confirm the trigger, requester, allowed tools, output contract, and approval gates before taking action. Keep facts source-linked and stop before any irreversible action.

skills.name: Permission Gate Skill
skills.description: Centralizes high-risk action checks for writes, secrets, customer data, billing, deploys, and public communications.
skills.activation: Load before calling any write-capable MCP tool or connector.
skills.instructions: Classify the action risk, check requester scope, require approval for high-risk calls, and record an audit note.

mcpServers.name: Claude Code Workspace MCP
mcpServers.description: Exposes task resources, prompt templates, connector tools, and audit records behind a permission-aware boundary.
mcpServers.approvalPolicy: Write actions and external notifications require task-scoped approval.

harnesses.name: Claude Code Release Harness
harnesses.description: Runs scenario checks, permission checks, and output-quality gates before the workflow is promoted.
harnesses.runsWhen: Before production rollout and whenever prompts, tools, or policies change.
harnesses.passCriteria: Critical scenarios pass, sources are present for factual claims, and approval gates fire for risky actions.
